transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. What brings you here today?

Um, yeah. Thanks. I guess... the main thing is work. I process insurance claims, and I just... I keep getting up from my desk. Like, a lot. Even when I know I'm supposed to just sit there and finish my reviews. It's becoming a problem.
When you get up from your desk, do you feel like you have intrusive or unwanted thoughts that make you anxious, or do you feel like you have to do something a certain way?
No, not really. I just... get up. I don't feel anxious or anything. Just can't seem to stay sitting.
When you get up from your desk, does it feel like you're acting on a sudden urge without thinking, or does it feel more like a habit that you just can't control?
I don't know. I guess... neither? I just get up. It's not really a sudden urge, and I wouldn't call it a habit. I just... stop sitting. I don't really think about it.
When you get up from your desk, does it feel like you're doing it without meaning to, like it just happens before you can stop yourself?
I mean... not really. It's not like I'm trying to stop myself and can't. I just... realize I'm standing up, or walking away from my computer. I don't really pay attention to how it happens.
Do you ever notice yourself getting up from your desk without being fully aware of why you're doing it, or do you usually have a reason, even if you don't think about it much?
I don't really know. I guess... I don't usually have a specific reason. I just sort of find myself standing. I haven't really thought about it that much.
Do you find yourself getting up from your desk more often when you're bored, trying to focus, or when your mind starts to wander?

I guess... maybe when my mind wanders. I don't know. But... that's actually the main thing that pushed me to come in. I just keep getting up from my workstation during the day. Even when I know I’m supposed to stay put and... finish my claim reviews. I just don't.
Do you often find it hard to stay focused on tasks like your claim reviews, even when you know they’re important, and does your mind tend to drift a lot during the day?

Yeah... I guess it drifts. Like, if people near me are talking about another claim, or... I just remember some random errand I need to run. My attention just kind of slides off what I’m reading. Then I have to... reread the same section a few times.
Looking back, did you have similar difficulties with staying focused or sitting still when you were a child, like in school or during other activities?

I guess... yeah, it’s not really a new thing. Um... back in elementary school, my teachers used to write stuff about it. Like... they’d say I was bright, but... I don't know, I was always losing my worksheets. Or I'd miss the instructions. They... usually had to keep reminding me to actually finish my classwork.
Do you find yourself getting up or losing focus easily in places other than work, like at home or when you're with friends?
I don't really know. I guess... mostly it's just work. I mean, at home I'm just doing my own thing, so... I don't really pay attention to it.
